objectives.note: validate-state.sh --fix crashed (jq: Cannot iterate over null) because its general dedup filter operates .file_scope |= (reduce ...) on every project without a null-guard, and 28 non-terminal projects (e.g. 412, 125) have file_scope: null. This is a pre-existing defect in the deployed .claude/scripts/validate-state.sh --fix block, unrelated to this task's edits, and out of scope to patch (.claude/** is a disposable deploy artifact per source-store-deploy-boundary.md). Applied the equivalent order-preserving dedup transform directly via state-write.sh, scoped strictly to project_number==178 (the one project this task's research confirmed as the sole Class A duplicate), which is null-safe by construction since it only touches 178 whose file_scope is a plain array. This is still a sanctioned mutex-guarded write, not a hand-edit.
